newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil-low sulphur centre stage in quiet mkt.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil-low sulphur centre stage in quiet mkt.

text.p: Activity on the cracked fuel oil market focused on low sulphur material on Tuesday.

Dealers said a cargo out of St Petersburg was sold into Italy on a floating basis and there were rumours of a cargo being sold in the Med. Prices for low sulphur cargoes were pegged close to the $119 fob NWE paid late on Monday for a 30,000 tonne cargo. Low sulphur Nov paper briefly touched $119 with deals concluded twice at $118.50.
High sulphur cracked cargoes were seen to have bottomed out by some traders who saw prices edging up tomorrow to $112-113 cif NWE.

But, there has been so little material on offer and only a few signs of buying interest. Russian straight run material continues to overhang the cracked market amid no concrete signs yet of any Russian export tariffs being levied.
High sulphur cracked barges were knocked lower to $109-110 fob a tonne with a deal concluded at $110. Traders said there were good supplies. The low sulphur barge sector was very flat.
